'''Toni Kroos''' ({{IPA|de|ˈtoːni kʁoːs|-|}}; born 4 January 1990) is a German former professional [[Association football|footballer]] who played as a [[midfielder]]. Regarded as one of the greatest midfielders of all time, he was known for his vision and pinpoint precision passing.{{refn|group=note|Attributed to multiple references:<ref name="90min.com_source_1">{{cite web|date=17 June 2020|title=The Best Deep-Lying Playmakers of All Time|url=https://www.90min.com/posts/the-best-deep-lying-playmakers-of-all-time|access-date=20 June 2023|website=90min|archive-date=11 August 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210811044047/https://www.90min.com/posts/the-best-deep-lying-playmakers-of-all-time|url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="90min.com_source_2">{{cite web|date=17 June 2020|title=Toni Kroos: The German Passing Master Who Conquered Europe|url=https://www.90min.com/posts/toni-kroos-the-german-passing-master-who-conquered-europe|access-date=20 June 2023|website=90min|archive-date=5 July 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240705210715/https://www.90min.com/posts/toni-kroos-the-german-passing-master-who-conquered-europe|url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="Wilson" /><ref name="Scholes" /><ref>{{cite web|title=Barcelona, Real Madrid, AC Milan, Santos: The greatest XIs in history|url=https://www.givemesport.com/88043110-barcelona-real-madrid-ac-milan-santos-the-greatest-xis-in-history|website=GiveMeSport|date=3 August 2022|access-date=6 August 2022|first=Danny|last=Ryan|archive-date=5 July 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240705210716/https://www.givemesport.com/88043110-barcelona-real-madrid-ac-milan-santos-the-greatest-xis-in-history/|url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="foxsports">{{cite web|title=Germany All-Time XI: Marco Reus, Michael Ballack Snubbed for Legendary Midfield Trio|url=https://www.foxsports.com/stories/soccer/germany-all-time-xi-marco-reus-michael-ballack-snubbed-legendary-midfield-trio|website=Fox Sports|access-date=5 January 2025}}</ref><ref name="espn_ancelotti">{{cite web|title=Real Madrid's Toni Kroos: 'One of the Best Ever' - Ancelotti|url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/40209161/real-madrid-toni-kroos-one-best-ever-ancelotti|website=ESPN|date=24 May 2024 |access-date=5 January 2025}}</ref><ref name="fourfourtwo_best_midfielders">{{cite web|title=Real Madrid: Is Toni Kroos One of the Best Midfielders of the 21st Century?|url=https://www.fourfourtwo.com/features/real-madrid-is-toni-kroos-one-of-the-best-midfielders-of-the-21st-century|website=FourFourTwo|date=5 July 2024 |access-date=5 January 2025}}</ref><ref name="goal">{{cite web|title=Best Men's Footballers of the 21st Century Ranked|url=https://www.goal.com/en/lists/best-mens-footballers-21st-century-ranked/bltfabf5fe89f36470a#cs782271762d130ab8|website=Goal|access-date=5 January 2025}}</ref><ref name="fourfourtwo_100_best">{{cite web|title=Ranked: The 100 Best Players of the 21st Century|url=https://www.fourfourtwo.com/features/ranked-the-100-best-players-of-the-21st-century/3|website=FourFourTwo|date=March 2023 |access-date=5 January 2025}}</ref><ref name="espn_top25">{{cite web|title=Ranking the Top 25 Men's Soccer Players of the 21st Century|url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/40490059/ranking-top-25-men-soccer-players-21st-century|website=ESPN|date=23 July 2024 |access-date=5 January 2025}}</ref><ref name="BBCBitesize">{{cite news |title=Relaxing river time and tabletop tekkerz: How to unwind like a premier league pro |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/bitesize/articles/znmtdnb |access-date=28 July 2026 |work=BBC Bitesize |date=1 August 2025}}</ref><ref name="FedererFootball">{{cite web |title='The Roger Federer of football' - Toni Kroos' perfectly-timed retirement typical of one of greatest midfielders of all time {{!}} Goal.com Canada |url=https://www.goal.com/en-ca/lists/roger-federer-football-toni-kroos-perfectly-timed-retirement-effortlessly-brilliant-central-midfielder/bltff18eaa73a532404 |publisher=www.goal.com |access-date=28 July 2026 |language=en-CA |date=6 July 2024}}</ref>}} Kroos played mainly as a [[central midfielder]] and occasionally as a [[defensive midfielder]]. Having won 34 trophies over his 17 year career, he is the third most decorated German footballer after [[Thomas Müller]] (35 trophies) and [[Manuel Neuer]] (36).<ref>{{cite web |title=Toni Kroos kann in Wembley seinen 34. Profititel gewinnen – deutscher Rekord |url=https://sport.sky.de/fussball/artikel/toni-kroos-kann-in-wembley-seinen-34-profititel-gewinnen-deutscher-rekord/13140726/35311 |access-date=2 June 2024 |website=Sky Sport |archive-date=23 May 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240523043301/https://sport.sky.de/fussball/artikel/amp/toni-kroos-kann-in-wembley-seinen-34-profititel-gewinnen-deutscher-rekord/13140726/35311 |url-status=live }}</ref>

Kroos began his senior club career at [[FC Bayern Munich|Bayern Munich]], where he debuted at age 17 in 2007. He was used sparingly for Bayern and he went on loan to fellow [[Bundesliga]] side [[Bayer 04 Leverkusen|Bayer Leverkusen]] for 18 months, where he became a key contributor. He returned to his parent club in 2010. With Bayern, Kroos won three Bundesliga titles (including two consecutive titles), a [[2012–13 Champions League|UEFA Champions League]], two [[DFB-Pokal]] trophies, and was named in the Bundesliga Team of the Season three times. In 2014, he joined [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] for a €25 million [[Transfer (association football)|transfer]].<ref>{{cite news |date=17 July 2014 |title=Toni Kroos joins Real Madrid from Bayern Munich for £20m |work=The Guardian |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2014/jul/17/toni-kroos-joins-real-madrid |access-date=16 July 2017 |archive-date=23 April 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190423131648/https://www.theguardian.com/football/2014/jul/17/toni-kroos-joins-real-madrid |url-status=live }}</ref>

In Madrid, Kroos won twenty-two trophies, including four [[La Liga]] titles and five [[UEFA Champions League]] trophies, three of which he won consecutively from 2016 to 2018. He was named in the Champions League team of the season each time. He was named in the [[FIFPRO#FIFA FIFPRO Men's World 11|FIFA FIFPRO World 11]] four times, [[UEFA Team of the Year]] three times, and the La Liga Team of the Season twice.<ref>{{cite news |date=4 June 2017 |title=Kroos becomes first German player to win five champions leagues |url=https://www.dfb.de/news/detail/kroos-becomes-first-german-player-to-win-three-champions-leagues-168584/ |publisher=DFB |access-date=19 July 2017 |archive-date=2 April 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190402172531/https://www.dfb.de/news/detail/kroos-becomes-first-german-player-to-win-three-champions-leagues-168584/ |url-status=live }}</ref><ref name="auto">{{cite news |date=22 December 2018 |title=Kroos becomes Club World Cup's most decorated player |url=https://www.realmadrid.com/en/news/2018/12/kroos-becomes-club-world-cups-most-decorated-player |access-date=10 January 2019 |publisher=Real Madrid CF |archive-date=23 December 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181223200802/https://www.realmadrid.com/en/news/2018/12/kroos-becomes-club-world-cups-most-decorated-player |url-status=live }}</ref> He was named the [[IFFHS World's Best Playmaker]] in 2014 and [[Footballer of the Year (Germany)|German Footballer of the Year]] in 2018 and 2024.

Kroos won the Golden Player award at the [[2006 UEFA European Under-17 Championship]] and the Golden Ball at the [[2007 FIFA U-17 World Cup]]. He made his senior debut for [[Germany national football team|Germany]] in 2010, at age 20, and appeared in seven major tournaments. With [[List of men's footballers with 100 or more international caps|114 international matches]] for Germany, Kroos is one of the top ten most capped German players. Kroos helped Germany win the [[2014 FIFA World Cup]], where he was top assister and named in the [[FIFA World Cup All-Star Team|All-Star Team]] and [[2014 FIFA World Cup awards#Dream Team|Dream Team]]. At [[UEFA Euro 2016]], he was named in the [[UEFA European Championship Teams of the Tournament#France 2016|Team of the Tournament]]. In 2024, Kroos retired from professional football.<ref>{{cite web |last=Sanderson |first=Tom |date=23 May 2024 |title=Real Madrid Legend Toni Kroos Reveals Why He Decided To Retire |url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/tomsanderson/2024/05/23/real-madrid-legend-toni-kroos-reveals-why-he-decided-to-retire/ |access-date=1 June 2024 |work=Forbes |archive-date=1 June 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240601213158/https://www.forbes.com/sites/tomsanderson/2024/05/23/real-madrid-legend-toni-kroos-reveals-why-he-decided-to-retire/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

==Early life==
Kroos was born in [[Greifswald]], [[Mecklenburg-Vorpommern]], [[East Germany]], on 4 January 1990.<ref name="Toni Kroos joins Real Madrid from Bayern Munich" /> He was born in the last year of East Germany's existence, several weeks after the [[fall of the Berlin Wall]] and nine months before [[German reunification]].<ref name=east>{{cite news |title=The beast from East Germany |url=https://www.marca.com/2014/07/17/en/football/real_madrid/1405616176.html |access-date=15 July 2024 |work=Marca |date=17 July 2014}}</ref> His mother Britta was an East German national [[badminton]] champion<ref name=east/> and his father Roland was also a footballer and at that time, he managed Hansa Rostock's youth team.<ref name=Kroosyouth/> He has a younger brother, [[Felix Kroos]], who was also a professional footballer.<ref name=Kroosyouth/>  During his youth, he was a mediocre student and spent a lot of time practicing football,<ref name=Kroosyouth/> however, he was well-behaved in class and well-liked among his peers at school.<ref name=Kroosyouth/>

==Club career==
===Early career===
Kroos first played for local club [[Greifswalder SC]], later transferring to the youth team of [[F.C. Hansa Rostock|Hansa Rostock]]. Kroos moved to [[FC Bayern Munich|Bayern Munich]]'s [[Bayern Munich Junior Team|youth setup]] in 2006. Kroos was missing up to 40 days during the school year due to training.<ref name="Kroosyouth">{{Cite news |last=Meyn |first=Jörn |date=22 May 2012 |title=Warum der junge Toni Kroos barfuß spielen musste |language=de |work=[[Die Welt]] |url=https://www.welt.de/sport/fussball/em-2012/article106354005/Warum-der-junge-Toni-Kroos-barfuss-spielen-musste.html |access-date=22 May 2012 |archive-date=9 August 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200809111146/https://www.welt.de/sport/fussball/em-2012/article106354005/Warum-der-junge-Toni-Kroos-barfuss-spielen-musste.html |url-status=live }}</ref>

For the [[2007–08 FC Bayern Munich season|2007–08 season]], at the age of 17, Kroos was promoted to Bayern's senior team. He made an astounding start to his [[Bundesliga]] career, making his debut for Bayern on 26 September 2007 in a 5–0 win against [[FC Energie Cottbus|Energie Cottbus]] and twice [[Assist (football)|assisting]] [[Miroslav Klose]] goals within 18 minutes of his appearance as a substitute.<ref name="hitzfeldsreview">{{Cite web |date=21 May 2007 |title=Hitzfeld's Review |url=http://www.fcbayern.t-com.de/en/news/news/2007/11966.php?fcb_sid=8a4081ab586df2a2f8c107ee8aeb7e3a |access-date=28 May 2007 |website=[[FC Bayern Munich]] |archive-date=26 September 2011 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110926233637/http://www.fcbayern.t-com.de/en/news/news/2007/11966.php?fcb_sid=8a4081ab586df2a2f8c107ee8aeb7e3a |url-status=live }}</ref> At the time of his debut, Kroos was the youngest player ever to represent Bayern in a professional match at {{age in years and days|1990|1|4|2007|9|26}} old, a record since broken by [[David Alaba]] in 2010.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Bayern Munich's 10 youngest debutants: Kroos, Alaba et al |url=https://www.bundesliga.com/en/bundesliga/news/bayern-munich-s-10-youngest-debutants-kroos-alaba-musiala-11721 |access-date=17 March 2024 |website=bundesliga.com – the official Bundesliga website |archive-date=23 January 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230123163537/https://www.bundesliga.com/en/bundesliga/news/bayern-munich-s-10-youngest-debutants-kroos-alaba-musiala-11721 |url-status=live }}</ref> On 25 October, Kroos earned Bayern a valuable victory away to [[Red Star Belgrade]] on his [[2007–08 UEFA Cup|UEFA Cup]] debut, coming on as a substitute in the 81st minute and providing an assist for Miroslav Klose and then scoring the winning goal, his first for the club, in stoppage time.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2 October 2013 |title=Kroos control |work=Sky Sports |url=http://www1.skysports.com/football/news/11096/8949565/kroos-control |access-date=7 October 2013 |archive-date=11 June 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200611210807/https://www.skysports.com/football/news/11096/8949565/kroos-control |url-status=live }}</ref> He made his first start for the club in a 3–1 defeat away at [[VfB Stuttgart]].{{citation needed|date=June 2020}} Kroos ended his first season with 20 appearances for Bayern, including six starts. He also scored three goals in 12 appearances for [[FC Bayern Munich II|Bayern Munich II]] in the [[2007–08 Regionalliga#South|Regionalliga Süd]].{{citation needed|date=June 2020}}

Despite being selected to start in Bayern's opening [[2008–09 Bundesliga]] match against [[Hamburger SV]], Kroos appeared less frequently for ''die Roten'' during the first half of the [[2008–09 FC Bayern Munich season|2008–09 season]]. On 5 November 2008, however, he made his [[UEFA Champions League]] debut as a 79th-minute substitute against [[ACF Fiorentina|Fiorentina]] in matchday four of the [[2008–09 UEFA Champions League group stage|group stage]].<ref>{{Cite news |title=Toni Kroos |publisher=UEFA |url=http://www.uefa.com/uefasupercup/season=2013/clubs/player=103147/profile/index.html |access-date=5 October 2013 |archive-date=20 October 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151020082544/http://www.uefa.com/uefasupercup/season=2013/clubs/player=103147/profile/index.html |url-status=dead }}</ref>

====Loan at Bayer Leverkusen====
On 31 January 2009, Bayern allowed Kroos to join [[Bayer 04 Leverkusen|Bayer Leverkusen]] on an 18-month [[Loan (sports)|loan]] to gain first team experience.<ref>{{Cite web |date=1 February 2009 |title=Bayern let Kroos join Bayer |url=http://www1.skysports.com/football/news/11890/4881504/ |access-date=31 August 2015 |website=Sky Sports |archive-date=29 August 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180829140006/http://www.skysports.com/football/news/11890/4881504 |url-status=live }}</ref> He made his debut on 28 February as a substitute in a 1–0 defeat against [[Hannover 96]]. On 12 April, he made his first Bundesliga start for Leverkusen, assisting the team's goal in a 1–1 draw with [[SV Werder Bremen|Werder Bremen]]. On 18 April 2009, he scored his first Bundesliga goal in a 2–1 loss to [[VfL Wolfsburg]].{{citation needed|date=June 2020}} On 30 May, Kroos appeared as a late substitute in the [[2009 DFB-Pokal Final]] against Werder Bremen, where Leverkusen were beaten 1–0 by a [[Mesut Özil]] goal.<ref>{{Cite news |title=Werders Triumph dank Özil |language=de |work=kicker |url=https://www.kicker.de/leverkusen-gegen-bremen-2009-dfb-pokal-865823/analyse |access-date=5 October 2013 |archive-date=25 April 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190425211012/http://www.kicker.de/news/fussball/dfbpokal/spielrunde/dfb-pokal/2008-09/6/865823/spielanalyse_bayer-leverkusen-9_werder-bremen-4.html |url-status=live }}</ref> During the 2008–09 season, Kroos made 13 appearances for Leverkusen in all competitions, scoring once.{{citation needed|date=June 2020}} Kroos established himself as a regular in the Leverkusen team in 2009–10, appearing all but one of Bayer's [[2009–10 Bayer 04 Leverkusen season|Bundesliga]] matches. Between matchdays 16 and 20, Kroos registered five goals and four assists in five Bundesliga matches, earning him back-to-back "player of the month" awards from [[Kicker (sports magazine)|''kicker'']] for December 2009 and January 2010.<ref>{{Cite news |title=Toni Kroos: Werdegang |language=de |work=toni-kroos.de |url=http://www.toni-kroos.de/ueber-toni/toni-sportlich/werdegang/ |access-date=5 October 2013 |archive-date=16 May 2014 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140516103230/http://www.toni-kroos.de/ueber-toni/toni-sportlich/werdegang |url-status=dead }}</ref> He ended the season with nine goals and 12 assists from 33 matches.{{citation needed|date=June 2020}}

===Bayern Munich===
[[File:Testspiel gegen FC Bayern München 14 (cropped).JPG|thumb|upright|Kroos with [[FC Bayern Munich|Bayern Munich]] in 2014]]
In the summer of 2010, on the expiration of his loan at Bayer Leverkusen, Kroos returned to Bayern Munich. When asked about his first team chances with Bayern, runner-up in the previous season's [[2009–10 UEFA Champions League|Champions League]], Kroos stated, "I want to play as often as possible!"<ref>{{Cite news |date=22 July 2010 |title=Kroos: "Ich will spielen, so oft wie möglich!" |language=de |work=Münchner Merkur |url=http://www.merkur-online.de/sport/fc-bayern/van-gaal-plaene-kroos-mm-850698.html |access-date=5 October 2013 |archive-date=11 February 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150211000152/http://www.merkur-online.de/sport/fc-bayern/van-gaal-plaene-kroos-mm-850698.html |url-status=live }}</ref> On 16 August 2010, he started against [[TSV Germania Windeck|Germania Windeck]] in the first round of the [[2010–11 DFB-Pokal|DFB-Pokal]], scoring the third goal in a 4–0 victory. On 29 October 2010, he scored his first league goal for the club, in a 4–1 win for the Bavarians against [[SC Freiburg]]. During the [[2010–11 FC Bayern Munich season|2010–11 season]], Kroos was a regular starter for Bayern in the [[2010–11 Bundesliga|Bundesliga]], DFB-Pokal and [[2010–11 UEFA Champions League|Champions League]]. He ended the season with 37 appearances in all competitions.{{citation needed|date=June 2020}}

During [[2011–12 FC Bayern Munich season|2011–12]], under [[Jupp Heynckes]], his former coach at Leverkusen, Kroos established himself as a first choice player from Bayern, forming a strong midfield partnership with [[Germany national football team|national team]] colleague [[Bastian Schweinsteiger]]. He played 51 matches in all competitions during the season, including the [[2012 UEFA Champions League Final]], where Bayern were beaten on [[Penalty shootout|penalties]] by [[Chelsea F.C.|Chelsea]] at the [[Allianz Arena]].{{citation needed|date=June 2020}}

Kroos was an important member of Bayern's [[Treble (association football)|treble]]-winning team during the [[2012–13 FC Bayern Munich season|2012–13 season]]. As the most advanced member of a midfield containing Schweinsteiger and [[Javi Martínez]], Kroos scored three goals in the team's opening four [[2012–13 Bundesliga|Bundesliga]] matches. He also scored his first Champions League goal in Bayern's opening [[2012–13 UEFA Champions League group stage|group]] match against [[Valencia CF|Valencia]]. After sustaining an injury in the first leg of the [[2012–13 UEFA Champions League|Champions League]] quarter-final against [[Juventus FC|Juventus]],<ref>{{Cite news |date=3 April 2013 |title=Bayern Munich's Toni Kroos expected to miss rest of season with injury |work=Sky Sports |url=http://www1.skysports.com/football/news/11890/8614985/bayern-munichs-toni-kroos-expected-to-miss-rest-of-season-with-injury |access-date=5 November 2013 |archive-date=12 March 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160312073722/http://www.skysports.com/football/news/11890/8614985/bayern-munichs-toni-kroos-expected-to-miss-rest-of-season-with-injury |url-status=live }}</ref> Kroos was unavailable for the remainder of the season, missing Bayern's successes in the [[2013 UEFA Champions League Final]], the [[2013 DFB-Pokal Final]] and the last seven matches of the Bundesliga season.{{citation needed|date=June 2020}}

Kroos returned to fitness for the start of the [[2013–14 FC Bayern Munich season|2013–14 season]] and, played in the [[2013 DFL-Supercup|German Super Cup]]<ref>{{Cite news |date=27 July 2013 |title=Reus eröffnet und beendet den Torreigen |language=de |work=kicker |url=https://www.kicker.de/dortmund-gegen-bayern-2013-dfl-supercup-1887827/analyse |access-date=11 March 2014 |archive-date=1 May 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190501232906/https://www.kicker.de/d-supercup-fb-1/2013/1/1887827/spielbericht_borussia-dortmund-17_bayern-muenchen-14.html |url-status=live }}</ref> and the [[2013 UEFA Super Cup|UEFA Super Cup]].<ref>{{Cite news |date=30 August 2013 |title=Neuer hält den Supercup fest |language=de |work=kicker |url=https://www.kicker.de/bayern-gegen-chelsea-2013-uefa-supercup-1887586/analyse |access-date=11 March 2014 |archive-date=22 June 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180622010545/http://www.kicker.de/news/fussball/intligen/intwettbewerbe/uefa-supercup/2013/1/1887586/spielanalyse_bayern-muenchen-14_fc-chelsea-505.html |url-status=live }}</ref> On 4 October 2013, he scored his first goal of the season in a 1–1 draw against former club Bayer Leverkusen in the [[2013–14 Bundesliga|Bundesliga]]. He started two matches for Bayern in the [[2013 FIFA Club World Cup]],<ref name="Toni Kroos » Club matches">{{Cite web |title=Toni Kroos " Club matches |url=https://www.worldfootball.net/person/pe3198/toni-kroos/club-matches/ |access-date=10 August 2015 |publisher=World Football |archive-date=15 September 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200915035828/https://www.worldfootball.net/player_summary/toni-kroos/2/ |url-status=live }}</ref> the first against [[Guangzhou Evergrande Taobao F.C.|Guangzhou Evergrande]] in the 3–0 semi-final win on 17 December 2013,<ref>{{Cite news |date=17 December 2013 |title=Bayern im Finale – Guangzhou kein Prüfstein |language=de |work=kicker |url=https://www.kicker.de/guangzhou-fc-gegen-bayern-2013-klub-weltmeisterschaft-1888095/analyse |access-date=11 March 2014 |archive-date=22 June 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180622032514/http://www.kicker.de/news/fussball/intligen/intwettbewerbe/klub-weltmeisterschaft/2013/3/1888095/spielbericht_guangzhou-yiyao-12640_bayern-muenchen-14.html |url-status=live }}</ref> and in the [[2013 FIFA Club World Cup final|final]] as the team beat [[Raja Casablanca]] 2–0.<ref>{{Cite news |date=21 December 2013 |title=Bayern Munich 2–0 Raja Casablanca |work=BBC Sport |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/0/football/25406403 |access-date=5 March 2014 |archive-date=24 September 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150924195627/http://www.bbc.com/sport/0/football/25406403 |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=21 December 2013 |title=FCB holt sich den fünften Titel |language=de |work=kicker |url=https://www.kicker.de/bayern-gegen-raja-casablanca-2013-klub-weltmeisterschaft-1888099/analyse |access-date=11 March 2014 |archive-date=22 June 2018 |url-status=live }}</ref> On 19 February 2014, Kroos scored his second goal of the season in a 2–0 [[2013–14 UEFA Champions League|Champions League]] win against [[Arsenal F.C.|Arsenal]].<ref>{{Cite news |date=20 February 2014 |title=Bayern's Toni Kroos and Thomas Müller leave Arsenal on the brink |work=The Guardian |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2014/feb/19/arsenal-bayern-munich-champions-league-matchreport |access-date=5 March 2014 |archive-date=27 June 2021 ===Real Madrid===
====2014–15: Debut season====
[[File:Toni Kroos - CdR - RM v ATL (cropped).jpg|thumb|upright|Kroos playing for [[Real Madrid]] in 2015]]

Prior to joining Real Madrid, Kroos had a deal in place to join [[Manchester United F.C.|Manchester United]] after agreeing terms with [[David Moyes]]. However, after Moyes was sacked and [[Louis van Gaal]] replaced him, the Dutch manager decided against signing Kroos. Around the time of the [[2014 FIFA World Cup|2014 World Cup]], he received a call from [[Carlo Ancelotti]].<ref>{{Cite news |last=Honigstein |first=Raphael |title=Toni Kroos: I'm blessed with the gift of not getting nervous – ever|work=The New York Times |date=25 February 2020 |url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/1628475/2020/02/25/toni-kroos-interview-real-madrid-manchester-city-champions-league-pep-guardiola/ |access-date=8 March 2020 |archive-date=1 May 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210501122100/https://theathletic.com/1628475/2020/02/25/toni-kroos-interview-real-madrid-manchester-city-champions-league-pep-guardiola/ |url-status=live }}</ref> On 17 July 2014, Spanish [[La Liga]] club [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] announced that they had reached an agreement for the transfer of Kroos, signing a six-year deal for an undisclosed fee.<ref name="Vertrag bis 2020! Kroos wechselt zu Real Madrid">{{Cite web |date=17 July 2014 |title=Vertrag bis 2020! Kroos wechselt zu Real Madrid |url=https://www.kicker.de/vertrag-bis-2020-kroos-wechselt-zu-real-madrid-608127/artikel |access-date=17 July 2014 |publisher=kicker |language=de |archive-date=7 October 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181007173821/http://www.kicker.de/news/fussball/intligen/startseite/608127/artikel_vertrag-bis-2020-kroos-wechselt-zu-real-madrid.html |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=17 July 2014 |title=Official statement |url=http://www.realmadrid.com/Official-Statement-Toni-Kroos |publisher=Real Madrid CF |access-date=17 July 2014 |archive-date=21 March 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160321112128/http://www.realmadrid.com/Official-Statement-Toni-Kroos |url-status=live }}</ref><ref name="Toni Kroos leaves Bayern Munich for Real Madrid">{{Cite news |date=17 July 2014 |title=Toni Kroos leaves Bayern Munich for Real Madrid |work=The Local |url=http://www.thelocal.de/20140717/german-toni-kroos-signs-for-real-madrid-from-bayern-munich |access-date=17 July 2014 |archive-date=3 March 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210303025603/http://www.thelocal.de/20140717/german-toni-kroos-signs-for-real-madrid-from-bayern-munich |url-status=live }}</ref><ref name="Toni Kroos joins Real Madrid from Bayern Munich">{{Cite news |date=17 July 2014 |title=Toni Kroos joins Real Madrid from Bayern Munich |work=BBC Sport |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/0/football/28342137 |access-date=17 July 2014 |archive-date=8 December 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151208060755/http://www.bbc.com/sport/0/football/28342137 |url-status=live }}</ref> The press reported that Kroos had cost between €24 and €30&nbsp;million.<ref name="Vertrag bis 2020! |url-status=live }}</ref>

Kroos became the ninth German player, after [[Günter Netzer]], [[Paul Breitner]], [[Uli Stielike]], [[Bernd Schuster]], [[Bodo Illgner]], [[Christoph Metzelder]], [[Mesut Özil]], and [[Sami Khedira]], to join Real Madrid.<ref>{{Cite news |date=17 July 2014 |title=Kroos-Wechsel zu Real ist perfekt |language=de |work=Süddeutsche Zeitung |url=http://www.sueddeutsche.de/sport/abschied-vom-fc-bayern-kroos-wechsel-zu-real-ist-perfekt-1.2050673 |access-date=20 July 2014 |archive-date=27 September 2020 presentation in front of 8000 supporters, he stated how Real Madrid is the "biggest club in the world" and is a "cut above Bayern".<ref>{{Cite news |date=17 July 2014 |title=Kroos: "Wechsel der }}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |last=Gladwell |first=Ben |date=18 July 2014 |title=Toni Kroos: Real a cut above Bayern |publisher=ESPN FC against [[Sevilla FC|Sevilla]] in the [[2014 UEFA Super Cup]] on 12 August 2014, winning his first trophy at Real Madrid.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Phillips |first=Rob |date=12 August 2014 |title=Super Titel mit Real Madrid |language=de |work=Die Welt |url=https://www.welt.de/sport/fussball/article131162405/Kroos-gewinnt-seinen-ersten-Titel-mit-Real-Madrid.html |access-date=12 August 2014 |archive-date=21 September 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200921103720/https://www.welt.de/sport/fussball/article131162405/Kroos-gewinnt-seinen-ersten-Titel-mit-Real-Madrid.html |url-status=live }}</ref>

Kroos was part of a midfield trio with [[James Rodríguez]] and [[Luka Modrić]] that led Real Madrid to 22-game winning run late in the year. On 8 November, Kroos scored his first goal for Real Madrid in a 5–1 win over [[Rayo Vallecano]], at home.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Rawson |first=Dov |title=Tekkers! Real Madrid's Toni Kroos scored a beautiful golazo in win over Rayo |url=http://www.101greatgoals.com/101ggvideos/golazos/tekkers-real-madrids-toni-kroos-scored-a-beautiful-goal-in-win-over-rayo-various-angles/ |access-date=26 October 2015 |website=101greatgoals.com |archive-date=4 March 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304053919/http://www.101greatgoals.com/101ggvideos/golazos/tekkers-real-madrids-toni-kroos-scored-a-beautiful-goal-in-win-over-rayo-various-angles/ |url-status=dead }}</ref> In December, he helped the team win the [[2014 FIFA Club World Cup]], leading the tournament in assists. He was named to the [[FIFPRO#FIFA FIFPRO Men's World 11|FIFA FIFPRO World 11]] and the [[UEFA Team of the Year]].<ref>{{cite web | last1=Beaard | first1=Raymond | url=https://fifpro.org/news/2014-fifa-fifpro-world-xi-how-they-finished/en/ | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190827024618/https://fifpro.org/news/2014-fifa-fifpro-world-xi-how-they-finished/en/ | archive-date=27 August 2019 | title=2014 FIFA FIFPro World XI: How they finished – FIFPro World Players' Union | work=FIFPro World Players' Union }}</ref>

====2015–19: Sustained domestic success and European dominance====
In 2015, Ancelotti was replaced by [[Rafa Benítez]] in Madrid's command. Benítez was replaced in the middle of the season by [[Zinedine Zidane]], under whom Kroos continued to be a key midfield player. Zidane said "We signed Toni because we want him to mark an era" and called Kroos "perfect for Madrid".<ref>{{Cite web |date=18 November 2015 |title=Zidane feels Kroos was Real Madrid's missing link |url=https://www.fourfourtwo.com/news/zidane-feels-kroos-was-real-madrids-missing-link |access-date=4 January 2020 |website=FourFourTwo |archive-date=4 January 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200104000948/https://www.fourfourtwo.com/news/zidane-feels-kroos-was-real-madrids-missing-link |url-status=live }}</ref> He was a regular starter when the team won the [[2015–16 UEFA Champions League|2015–16 Champions League]], his second Champions League trophy.<ref>{{Cite web |date=28 May 2016 |title=Spot-on Real Madrid defeat Atlético in final again |url=https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/news/022d-0e957c5979eb-37493cb53cd0-1000--spot-on-real-madrid-defeat-atletico-in-final-again/ |publisher=UEFA |access-date=29 May 2016 |archive-date=10 January 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180110225552/http://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/season=2016/matches/round=2000638/match=2015789/postmatch/report/index.html |url-status=live }}</ref> ''Los Blancos''' triumph at [[San Siro]] meant that Kroos became the first-ever German to lift the Champions League trophy with two clubs.<ref>{{Cite web |date=30 May 2016 |title=Toni Kroos focused on Euros 2016 after Real Madrid UCL win |url=http://www.espnfc.com/real-madrid/story/2883158/toni-kroos-focused-on-euros-2016-after-real-madrid-ucl-win |website=espnfc.com |access-date=31 May 2016 |archive-date=3 June 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160603143723/http://www.espnfc.com/real-madrid/story/2883158/toni-kroos-focused-on-euros-2016-after-real-madrid-ucl-win |url-status=live }}</ref>
[[File:CSKA-RM18 (25).jpg|thumb|left|upright|Kroos playing for Real Madrid in 2018]]

In 2016, Kroos became a part of a collaboration between the [[German Football Association]] and [[The LEGO Group]], who in May released a Europe-exclusive [[Lego Minifigures (theme)|collectible minifigure series]], with Kroos featured as the tenth of sixteen [[minifigure]]s in the collection.<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.lego.com/en-my/aboutus/news/2019/november/new-lego-dfb-minifigure-series |title= This squad will be playing for the LEGO Minifigure Series "DFB – Die Mannschaft" |author= Lego Group |date= until 2022, and by the end of the year he was once again nominated to the [[FIFPRO#FIFA FIFPRO Men's World 11|FIFA FIFPRO World 11]] and the [[UEFA Team of the Year]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=12 October 2016 |title=Official announcement: Kroos |url=http://www.realmadrid.com/en/news/2016/10/official-announcement-kroos |access-date=12 October 2016 |publisher=Real Madrid CF |archive-date=12 October 2016 the 81st minute of the game against [[RC Celta de Vigo|Celta Vigo]] as Real Madrid won their first home game of the [[La Liga]] season by 2–1.<ref>{{Cite web |agency=Reuters |date=27 August 2016 |title=Toni Kroos nets late winner for Real Madrid against Celta Vigo |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2016/aug/27/real-madrid-celta-vigo-la-liga-match-report |access-date=21 November 2018 ====2019–2021: Fifth FIFA Club World Cup title====
[[File:FC RB Salzburg v.Real Madrid (Testspiel, 7. August 2019) 23.jpg|thumb|left|upright|Kroos playing for Real Madrid in 2019]]
On 22 December 2018, Kroos won his record fifth [[FIFA Club World Cup]] after his team defeated [[Al Ain FC]] with a 4–1 margin in the [[2018 FIFA Club World Cup Final|final]].<ref name="auto" /> On 20 May 2019, he extended his contract with the club until 2023.<ref>{{Cite web |date=20 May 2019 |title=Toni Kroos signed his contract extension with Real Madrid |url=https://www.realmadrid.com/en/news/2019/05/toni-kroos-signed-his-contract-extension-with-real-madrid |access-date=20 May 2019 |publisher=[[Real Madrid CF]] |archive-date=30 November 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191130185300/https://www.realmadrid.com/en/news/2019/05/toni-kroos-signed-his-contract-extension-with-real-madrid |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |title=Toni Kroos: Real Madrid midfielder signs new four-year deal |work=BBC Sport |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/48333632 |access-date=20 May 2019 |archive-date=27 July 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200727092320/https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/48333632 |url-status=live }}</ref> On 17 August 2019, Kroos opened his goal account for the campaign in the [[2019–20 La Liga|La Liga]] season opener against Celta Vigo at [[Balaídos]] in a 3–1 win with a long range effort.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Celta-Real Madrid: 1–3: Real Madrid start LaLiga with a great win at Balaídos|url=https://www.realmadrid.com/en/news/2019/08/1-3-real-madrid-start-laliga-with-a-great-win-at-balaidos|access-date=11 April 2021|website=Real Madrid C.F. – Web Oficial|archive-date=1 October 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231001140229/https://www.realmadrid.com/en/news/2019/08/1-3-real-madrid-start-laliga-with-a-great-win-at-balaidos|url-status=live}}</ref> On 22 October 2019, he scored the winning goal in a 1–0 victory over [[Galatasaray S.K. (football)|Galatasaray]] in his [[List of footballers with 100 or more UEFA Champions League appearances|100th appearance]] in the Champions League.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.realmadrid.com/en/news/2019/10/22/kroos-marks-100th-champions-league-appearance-with-goal |title=Kroos marks 100th Champions League appearance with goal |website=Real Madrid |date=22 October 2019 |access-date=8 June 2022 |archive-date=16 January 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240116091326/https://www.realmadrid.com/en/news/2019/10/22/kroos-marks-100th-champions-league-appearance-with-goal |url-status=live }}</ref>

On 8 January 2020, Kroos scored his first [[Supercopa de España|Supercopa]] goal directly from a [[corner kick]] against [[Valencia CF|Valencia]] in the [[2019–20 Supercopa de España]] semi-final in [[Jeddah]] as Los Blancos won 3–1.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Valencia – Real Madrid {{!}} Spanish Super Cup|url=https://www.realmadrid.com/en/football/games/spanish-super-cup/valencia-real-madrid-2020-01-08|access-date=11 April 2021|publisher=Real Madrid C.F.|archive-date=11 April 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210411015129/https://www.realmadrid.com/en/football/games/spanish-super-cup/valencia-real-madrid-2020-01-08|url-status=live}}</ref> Three days later, Real Madrid won the [[2020 Supercopa de España Final|Supercopa]] after beating the local rivals [[Atlético Madrid]] on penalties.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Real Madrid beat Atlético Madrid on penalties to seal Super Cup |url=https://en.as.com/en/2020/01/12/football/1578849539_466578.html |access-date=12 January 2020 |website=as.com |archive-date=16 February 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200216014851/https://en.as.com/en/2020/01/12/football/1578849539_466578.html |url-status=dead }}</ref> On 16 February, Kroos again scored against Celta Vigo, this time at the Bernabeu in a 2–2 league draw.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Real Madrid-Celta: 2–2: Real Madrid draws and stay top of the league|url=https://www.realmadrid.com/en/news/2020/02/16/2-2-real-madrid-draws-and-stay-top-of-the-league|access-date=11 April 2021|website=Real Madrid C.F. – Web Oficial|archive-date=5 July 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240705210718/https://www.realmadrid.com/en-US|url-status=live}}</ref> This was his sixth goal against the Galician club, meaning he had scored against them more than any other team in his career.{{Citation needed|date=November 2021}}

On 16 June, when La Liga restarted after a three-month hiatus due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain|COVID-19 pandemic]], Kroos scored Real Madrid's first official goal at the [[Alfredo Di Stéfano Stadium]] in just four minutes in an eventual 3–1 win over [[SD Eibar|Eibar]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Real Madrid – Éibar {{!}} La Liga Matchday 28|url=https://www.realmadrid.com/en/football/games/la-liga/real-madrid-eibar---2020-03-15|access-date=11 April 2021|publisher=Real Madrid C.F.|archive-date=1 June 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230601211157/https://www.realmadrid.com/en/football/games/la-liga/real-madrid-eibar---2020-03-15|url-status=live}}</ref> One month later, Real Madrid went on a ten-game winning run and won the [[2019–20 La Liga]] title with Kroos featuring in all 11 matches post-lockdown.<ref name="Liga">{{Cite web |date=17 July 2020 |title=Real Madrid win the longest LaLiga Santander season |url=https://www.marca.com/en/football/real-madrid/2020/07/17/5f10db2146163f3c2c8b45d7.html |access-date=17 July 2020 |website=Marca |location=Spain |archive-date=18 July 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200718165201/https://www.marca.com/en/football/real-madrid/2020/07/17/5f10db2146163f3c2c8b45d7.html |url-status=live }}</ref> On 8 August, Kroos' season came to an end as Manchester City eliminated Madrid in the Champions League Round of 16 (4–2 on aggregate).<ref>{{Cite news|title=Man City beat Real in Champions League|work=BBC Sport|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/53683510|access-date=11 April 2021|archive-date=1 February 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210201000538/https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/53683510|url-status=live}}</ref>

====2021–2024: Further honours and retirement====
On 10 April 2021, Kroos scored his first [[El Clásico]] goal against [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]] which came from a free-kick in the 28th minute at the Di Stefano Stadium which proved to be the winner in a vital 2–1 league win to send Los Blancos to the top of the league. This was Kroos' first free kick goal for Real Madrid in just his sixth attempt.<ref>{{Cite web|title=2–1: Victory in the Clásico to move top of the table|url=https://www.realmadrid.com/en/news/2021/04/10/2-1-victory-in-the-clasico-to-move-top-of-the-table|access-date=11 April 2021|website=Real Madrid C.F.|archive-date=16 January 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240116091326/https://www.realmadrid.com/en/news/2021/04/10/2-1-victory-in-the-clasico-to-move-top-of-the-table|url-status=live}}</ref> In the [[2021–22 UEFA Champions League]], Kroos won his fifth title in the competition, scoring two goals in twelve appearances.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.si.com/fannation/soccer/futbol/news/8-real-madrid-players-equal-cristiano-ronaldos-ucl-record |title=Nine Real Madrid Players Equal Cristiano Ronaldo's Champions League Record |website=si.com |date=28 May 2022 |access-date=8 June 2022 |archive-date=24 February 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240224014006/https://www.si.com/fannation/soccer/futbol/news/8-real-madrid-players-equal-cristiano-ronaldos-ucl-record |url-status=live }}</ref>

On 10 August 2022, Kroos started the [[2022–23 Real Madrid CF season|2022–23 season]] by winning his fourth [[2022 UEFA Super Cup|UEFA Super Cup]] against [[Eintracht Frankfurt]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Real Madrid 2–0 Eintracht Frankfurt: Five-star Madrid triumph in Helsinki |url=https://www.uefa.com/uefasupercup/news/0278-15d6268709ab-38bef8ec34df-1000--highlights-report-real-madrid-win-the-super-cup |website=[[UEFA]] |access-date=12 September 2022 |date=10 August 2022 |archive-date=5 October 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231005195025/https://www.uefa.com/uefasupercup/news/0278-15d6268709ab-38bef8ec34df-1000--highlights-report-real-madrid-win-the-super-cup/ |url-status=dead }}</ref> This match would prove to be significant because it was the last time the famous trio commonly known by fans as ''KCM'' (Kroos, [[Casemiro]] and [[Luka Modrić|Modrić]]) would start a match together. Casemiro would move on to Manchester United a week later.<ref>{{cite web |title=Casemiro signs for United |url=https://www.manutd.com/en/news/detail/casemiro-signs-for-man-utd-official-press-release-22-august-2022 |website=www.manutd.com |access-date=12 September 2022 |archive-date=22 August 2022 matchday of the [[2022–23 UEFA Champions League]] season, Kroos received the UEFA Man of the Match for his performance against [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]] at [[Celtic Park]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Kroos named Player of the Match against Celtic: "It was a deserved win" |url=https://www.realmadrid.com/en/news/2022/09/06/kroos-named-player-of-the-match-against-celtic-it-was-a-deserved-win |website=Real ==International career==
[[File:Toni Kroos, Germany national football team (01).jpg|thumb|Kroos with Germany in 2011]]

===Youth teams===
In the [[2007 FIFA U-17 World Cup]], Toni Kroos was awarded the Golden Ball as the tournament's best player and also won the ''Bronze Shoe'' after scoring five goals.<ref>{{Cite web |date=9 September 2007 |title=Shining Starlets Pocket Prizes |url=https://www.fifa.com/u17worldcup/news/newsid=591322.html#shining+starlets+pocket+prizes/kroos |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070912015252/http://www.fifa.com/u17worldcup/news/newsid=591322.html#shining+starlets+pocket+prizes/kroos |url-status=dead |archive-date=12 September 2007 |access-date=9 September 2007 |publisher=[[FIFA]]}}</ref> Kroos' debut for the [[Germany national under-21 football team|national U-21 team]] came on 5 September 2008 in a [[2009 UEFA European Under-21 Football Championship Qualification Group 9|2009 Euro U-21 Championship Qualifier]] against [[Northern Ireland national under-21 football team|Northern Ireland]] and scored the opening goal in the 11th minute,<ref>{{Cite web |date=5 September 2008 |title=Kroos scores in his first match |url=https://www.dfb.de/index.php?id=500016&tx_dfbnews_pi1%5BshowUid%5D=15620 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080914064919/https://www.dfb.de/index.php?id=500016&tx_dfbnews_pi1%5BshowUid%5D=15620 |archive-date=14 September 2008 |access-date=5 September 2008 |website=[[German Football Association]]}}</ref> his second goal for the U-21 side was goal in Germany's 1–0 win over Italy, a precise long-range shot in the angle. It came as a surprise that coach [[Horst Hrubesch]] left him out of Germany's U-21 squad for [[2009 UEFA European Under-21 Football Championship|Euro 2009]], and Germany went on to win the tournament without him.<ref>{{Cite web |date=13 June 2009 |title=Darum sind Kroos und Baumjohann nicht dabei |url=http://www.tz-online.de/sport/nationalmannschaft/tz-hrubesch-interview-353105.html |access-date=12 December 2011 |publisher=tz-online.de |language=de |archive-date=1 October 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231001140508/http://www.tz-online.de/sport/nationalmannschaft/tz-hrubesch-interview-353105.html |url-status=live }}</ref>

===2010 World Cup===
In January 2010, Kroos was called up to the senior [[Germany national football team|Germany]] team for the first time, for a training session in [[Sindelfingen]]<ref>{{Cite web |date=21 January 2010 |title=Robert Huth ist wieder da |url=https://www.kicker.de/hunt-sagt-loew-ab-519918/artikel |access-date=22 January 2010 |website=[[Kicker (sports magazine)|kicker sportmagazin]] |language=de |archive-date=18 July 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230718103522/https://www.kicker.de/news/fussball/nationalelf/startseite/519918/artikel_Robert-Huth-ist-wieder-da.html |url-status=live }}</ref> and was named in the squad for the following match, a friendly against [[Argentina national football team|Argentina]] on 3 March 2010, in which he subsequently made his debut for the national side.<ref>{{Cite web |date=26 February 2010 |title=DFB-Team mit Müller und Kroos |url=https://www.kicker.de/dfb-team-ohne-jansen-521561/artikel |access-date=26 February 2010 |website=[[Kicker (sports magazine)|kicker sportmagazin]] |language=de |archive-date=18 July 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230718101744/https://www.kicker.de/news/fussball/nationalelf/startseite/521561/artikel_DFB-Team-mit-Mueller-und-Kroos.html |url-status=live }}</ref>

Kroos was selected to [[Joachim Löw]]'s [[2010 FIFA World Cup squads#Germany|23-man squad]] for the [[2010 FIFA World Cup]] in South Africa. He made his [[FIFA World Cup]] debut in Germany's final group-stage match versus [[Ghana national football team|Ghana]], coming on in the 80th minute for Bastian Schweinsteiger, with Germany leading 1–0. He made further appearances as a substitute in the [[2010 FIFA World Cup knockout stage#Argentina vs Germany|quarter-finals]] against Argentina, in the [[2010 FIFA World Cup knockout stage#Germany vs Spain|semi-finals]] against [[Spain national football team|Spain]] and in the [[2010 FIFA World Cup knockout stage#Third place play-off|third place play-off]] against [[Uruguay national football team|Uruguay]].{{citation needed|date=June 2020}}

===Euro 2012===
[[File:UEFA Euro 2012 qualifying - Austria vs Germany 2011-06-03 (06).jpg|thumb|Kroos (left) battles [[Julian Baumgartlinger]] for the ball in a [[UEFA Euro 2012 qualifying|Euro 2012 qualifying]] match against [[Austria national football team|Austria]] in 2011]]

Kroos established himself as a regular starter in Germany's [[UEFA Euro 2012 qualifying|qualification]] campaign for [[UEFA Euro 2012]], playing in eight out of a possible ten games. Germany won all ten qualifying matches to top [[UEFA Euro 2012 qualifying Group A|group A]]. After qualification was already ensured, Kroos scored his first two international goals, both with his strong right foot. Notably, both Kroos' goals were Germany's first after falling behind in the respective matches, both of which were drawn away friendlies, against the two Euro 2012 hosts – [[Poland national football team|Poland]] and [[Ukraine national football team|Ukraine]]. National coach [[Joachim Löw]] also praised him: "How Toni distributes the ball, how he receives it, is very good. He's technically excellent ... He has made progress in the last few matches, I'm extremely satisfied with the player."<ref>{{Cite web |date=18 April 2012 |title=Better than Schweinsteiger |url=http://www.goal.com/en-ie/news/3920/features/2012/04/18/3043781/better-than-schweinsteiger-complete-package-toni-kroos-comes |access-date=4 January 2013 |publisher=goal.com |archive-date=20 April 2012 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120420061809/http://www.goal.com/en-ie/news/3920/features/2012/04/18/3043781/better-than-schweinsteiger-complete-package-toni-kroos-comes |url-status=live }}</ref> At the tournament finals, Kroos appeared as a substitute in all three of Germany's [[UEFA Euro 2012 Group B|Group B]] matches. For the [[UEFA Euro 2012 knockout stage#Germany vs Italy|semi-final]] match against [[Italy national football team|Italy]], Löw selected the naturally attacking Kroos to [[Marking (association football)|man mark]] Italy's [[playmaker]] [[Andrea Pirlo]]. The decision was heavily criticised as Germany lost the match 2–1.<ref>{{Cite news |date=30 June 2012 |title=Euro 2012: Spain v Italy&nbsp;– five key issues |work=The Telegraph |url=https://www.telegraph.co.uk/sport/football/teams/spain/9367497/Euro-2012-Spain-v-Italy-five-key-issues.html |archive-url=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/20220111/https://www.telegraph.co.uk/sport/football/teams/spain/9367497/Euro-2012-Spain-v-Italy-five-key-issues.html |archive-date=11 January 2022 |url-access=subscription |url-status=live |access-date=5 October 2013}}{{cbignore}}</ref><ref>{{Cite magazine |date=28 September 2012 |title=Kroos emerges as talk of Bayern Munich, challenging German stars |magazine=Sports Illustrated |url=http://sportsillustrated.cnn.com/2012/writers/raphael_honigstein/09/28/toni-kroos-bayern-munich/index.html |access-date=5 October 2013 |archive-date=15 October 2013 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131015001651/http://sportsillustrated.cnn.com/2012/writers/raphael_honigstein/09/28/toni-kroos-bayern-munich/index.html |url-status=dead }}</ref>

===2014 World Cup===
[[File:Germany and Argentina face off in the final of the World Cup 2014 -2014-07-13 (20) (cropped).jpg|thumb|right|Kroos (left) playing in the [[2014 World Cup final]]]]
During Germany's [[2014 FIFA World Cup qualification – UEFA Group C|2014 World Cup qualifying campaign]], Kroos scored his first two competitive international goals in a 6–1 win over the [[Republic of Ireland national football team|Republic of Ireland]] in [[Dublin]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/19922447 |title=Republic of Ireland 1-6 Germany |publisher=BBC Sport |date=12 October 2012 }}</ref> On 6 September 2013, he scored the team's second goal in a 3–0 win over [[Austria national football team|Austria]].<ref>{{cite web |last=Röber |first=Philip |url=https://www.uefa.com/european-qualifiers/news/020d-0e14571eae77-e46dec6c37af-1000--world-cup-in-sight-as-germany-see-off-austria/ |title=World Cup in sight as Germany see off Austria |publisher=UEFA |date=6 September 2013 }}</ref>

Kroos was named in Germany's squad for the [[2014 FIFA World Cup|2014 World Cup]].<ref>{{Cite news |date=2 June 2014 |title=Germany World Cup 2014 squad |work=The Telegraph |url=https://www.telegraph.co.uk/sport/football/teams/germany/10810439/Germany-World-Cup-2014-squad.html |archive-url=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/20220111/https://www.telegraph.co.uk/sport/football/teams/germany/10810439/Germany-World-Cup-2014-squad.html |archive-date=11 January 2022 |url-access=subscription |url-status=live |access-date=22 June 2014}}{{cbignore}}</ref> In the team's opening match, a 4–0 win over [[Portugal national football team|Portugal]], Kroos started in midfield and assisted [[Mats Hummels]] for Germany's second goal, in addition to helping create [[Thomas Müller]]'s second goal for Germany's third of the match.<ref>{{Cite news |date=16 June 2014 |title=Germany 4–0 Portugal |publisher=BBC |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/0/football/25285106 |access-date=22 June 2014 |archive-date=24 January 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160124170829/http://www.bbc.com/sport/0/football/25285106 |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Wilson |first1=Paul |title=Thomas Müller’s hat-trick and Pepe’s petulance sink bedraggled Portugal |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2014/jun/16/germany-portugal-world-cup-2014-group-g-match-report |access-date=28 July 2026 |work=The Guardian |date=16 June 2014}}</ref> Then in the quarter final the only goal scored by Mats Hummels against [[France national football team|France]] came from his free kick.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Hytner |first=David |date=4 July 2014 |title=France 0–1 Germany {{!}} World Cup quarter-final match report |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2014/jul/04/france-germany-world-cup-2014-quarter-final-match-report |access-date=21 November 2018 |website=The Guardian |archive-date=28 February 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210228104641/https://www.theguardian.com/football/2014/jul/04/france-germany-world-cup-2014-quarter-final-match-report |url-status=live }}</ref> In the [[2014 FIFA World Cup knockout stage#Semi-finals|semi-final]] against the host nation [[Brazil national football team|Brazil]], Kroos scored two goals two minutes apart (24' and 26') in Germany's [[Brazil v Germany (2014 FIFA World Cup)|7–1 win]].<ref>{{Cite news |last=Knight |first=Ben |date=8 July 2014 |title=Germany demolish Brazil in surreal World Cup semi-final |publisher=Deutsche Welle |url=http://www.dw.de/germany-demolish-brazil-in-surreal-world-cup-semifinal/a-17768416 |access-date=9 July 2014 |archive-date=9 July 2014 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140709015956/http://www.dw.de/germany-demolish-brazil-in-surreal-world-cup-semifinal/a-17768416 |url-status=live }}</ref> He also recorded his fourth assist of the tournament, crossing for Thomas Müller's opening goal, and was named [[man of the match]] by [[FIFA]].<ref>{{Cite news |title=MAN OF THE MATCH |publisher=FIFA |url=https://www.fifa.com/worldcup/awards/man-of-the-match/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140627144855/http://www.fifa.com/worldcup/awards/man-of-the-match/ |url-status=dead |archive-date=27 June 2014 |access-date=9 July 2014}}</ref> Kroos has been nicknamed ''Garçom'' ("waiter" in Portuguese) by the Brazilians for precisely delivering most passes to the strikers.<ref>{{Cite web |date=19 June 2014 |title="Garçom" Kroos serviert Bälle – WM als Schaufenster |url=http://www.sueddeutsche.de/news/sport/fussball-garom-kroos-serviert-baelle---wm-als-schaufenster-dpa.urn-newsml-dpa-com-20090101-140619-99-03171 |access-date=22 December 2014 |publisher=Süddeutsche.de |language=de |archive-date=22 December 2014 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141222031508/http://www.sueddeutsche.de/news/sport/fussball-garom-kroos-serviert-baelle---wm-als-schaufenster-dpa.urn-newsml-dpa-com-20090101-140619-99-03171 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

On 11 July, Kroos was named on the ten-man shortlist for FIFA's [[2014 FIFA World Cup#Golden Ball|Golden Ball]] award for the tournament's best player.<ref>{{Cite news |date=11 July 2014 |title=World Cup 2014: Fifa announces Golden Ball shortlist |publisher=BBC |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/0/football/28274011 |access-date=12 July 2014 |archive-date=12 July 2014 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140712035351/http://www.bbc.com/sport/0/football/28274011 |url-status=live }}</ref> The [[Castrol Performance Index]], the official statistical analyser of the World Cup, rated Kroos as the best player at the 2014 World Cup, with a rating of 9.79 out of 10.<ref name="castrol">{{Cite web |title=Castrol Index Full Ranking |url=https://www.fifa.com/worldcup/statistics/castrol-index/ranking.html |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150117012017/http://www.fifa.com/worldcup/statistics/castrol-index/ranking.html |archive-date=17 January 2015 |access-date=17 July 2014 |publisher=[[FIFA]]}}</ref> Kroos is considered the only player from the former [[East Germany]] to ever win the World Cup.<ref>{{Cite web |date=24 June 2014 |title=The paradox of East German representation in the national team |url=http://bundesligafanatic.com/20140624/the-paradox-of-east-german-representation-in-the-national-team/ |website=Bundesliga Fanatic |access-date=24 June 2018 |archive-date=24 June 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180624035743/http://bundesligafanatic.com/20140624/the-paradox-of-east-german-representation-in-the-national-team/ |url-status=usurped }}</ref>

===2018 World Cup===
On 4 June 2018, Kroos was included in Germany's final 23-man squad for the [[2018 FIFA World Cup]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Germany announce final World Cup squad, with Manuel Neuer, without Leroy Sané |url=http://www.dw.com/en/germany-announce-final-world-cup-squad-with-manuel-neuer-without-leroy-san%C3%A9/a-44064011 |access-date=4 June 2018 |publisher=Deutsche Welle |archive-date=9 August 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200809080555/https://www.dw.com/en/germany-announce-final-world-cup-squad-with-manuel-neuer-without-leroy-san%C3%A9/a-44064011 |url-status=live }}</ref> On 23 June, Kroos scored from a free-kick in stoppage time against [[Sweden men's national football team|Sweden]] to resurrect Germany's World Cup hopes with a 2–1 victory.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Hytner |first=David |date=23 June 2018 |title=Toni Kroos brings off late miracle for Germany to stun Sweden |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2018/jun/23/toni-kroos-germany-sweden-world-cup-match-report |website=The Guardian |access-date=21 July 2018 |archive-date=30 July 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180730225038/https://www.theguardian.com/football/2018/jun/23/toni-kroos-germany-sweden-world-cup-match-report |url-status=live }}</ref> But in their next and last group stage match, his side were knocked out by [[South Korea national football team|South Korea]] after losing 2–0 four days later.<ref>{{Cite web |title=South Korea 2–0 Germany: World Cup 2018 – as it happened |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/live/2018/jun/27/world-cup-2018-south-korea-v-germany-live |access-date=31 July 2018 |website=The Guardian |date=27 June 2018 |archive-date=17 September 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180917222333/https://www.theguardian.com/football/live/2018/jun/27/world-cup-2018-south-korea-v-germany-live |url-status=live }}</ref>

===2020–21 UEFA Nations League===
On 13 October 2020, Kroos played his 100th match for Germany in a 3–3 draw against [[Switzerland national football team|Switzerland]] in the [[2020–21 UEFA Nations League A]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.eurosport.de/fussball/uefa-nations-league/2020-2021/dfb-team-deutschland-schweiz-jogi-loew-gnabry-havertz_sto7948503/story.shtml |title=DFB-Elf holt nach wildem Schlagabtausch Remis gegen den Schweiz |website=eurosport.de |language=de |date=13 October 2020 |access-date=13 October 2020 |archive-date=3 December 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201203073227/https://www.eurosport.de/fussball/uefa-nations-league/2020-2021/dfb-team-deutschland-schweiz-jogi-loew-gnabry-havertz_sto7948503/story.shtml |url-status=live }}</ref>

===Euro 2020 and initial retirement from international play===
On 19 May 2021, he was selected to the squad for the [[UEFA Euro 2020]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.kicker.de/em-kader-offiziell-loew-beruft-mueller-hummels-und-volland-804642/artikel|title=EM-Kader offiziell: Löw beruft Müller, Hummels und Volland|date=19 May 2021|website=[[Kicker (magazine)|Kicker]]|language=de|access-date=19 May 2021|archive-date=7 June 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210607123628/https://www.kicker.de/em-kader-offiziell-loew-beruft-mueller-hummels-und-volland-804642/artikel|url-status=live}}</ref>

Three days after the team lost 2–0 against [[England national football team|England]] in the Round of 16 on 29 June, Kroos announced his retirement from international football, after being heavily criticised for his poor performance.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |date=11 July 2021 |title=Hoeness taunts Kroos: He's got no place in today's football |url=https://www.marca.com/en/football/real-madrid/2021/07/11/60eaf24646163f193a8b458c.html |access-date=14 February 2024 |website=MARCA |archive-date=11 July 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210711135938/https://www.marca.com/en/football/real-madrid/2021/07/11/60eaf24646163f193a8b458c.html |url-status=live }}</ref><ref name=":2">{{Cite web |date=19 July 2021 |title='I don't agree with the way he plays' – Matthaus criticises Kroos as Germany Euro 2020 fallout rumbles on {{!}} Sporting News Canada |url=https://www.sportingnews.com/ca/soccer/news/i-dont-agree-with-the-way-he-plays-matthaus-criticises-kroos-as-germany-euro-2020-fallout-rumbles-on/11yh4gqe30azj1eg1cspot4ria |access-date=14 February 2024 |website=www.sportingnews.com |archive-date=14 February 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240214162235/https://www.sportingnews.com/ca/soccer/news/i-dont-agree-with-the-way-he-plays-matthaus-criticises-kroos-as-germany-euro-2020-fallout-rumbles-on/11yh4gqe30azj1eg1cspot4ria |url-status=live }}</ref><ref name=":3">{{Cite web |date=14 February 2024 |title=Germany legend Lothar Matthäus hits out at Real Madrid star Toni Kroos |url=https://onefootball.com/en/news/germany-legend-lothar-matthaeus-hits-out-at-real-madrid-star-toni-kroos-33407646 |access-date=14 February 2024 |website=OneFootball |archive-date=14 February 2024 Honorary Bayern Munich president [[Uli Hoeneß]] stated that Kroos' style of play which emphasizes horizontal passing doesn't fit the modern game.<ref name=":1" /> Former German international and [[Ballon d'Or]] winner [[Lothar Matthäus]] expressed similar sentiments, stating that he does not agree with Kroos style of play and that "Kroos is no longer international class".<ref name=":2" /><ref |url=https://www.dfb.de/en/news/detail/toni-kroos-retires-from-international-football-229619/?no_cache=1&cHash=a797bf2cdb6090157ac2f2dc26e06c09 |accessdate=2 July 2021 |website=dfb.de |archive-date=12 |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |date=2 July 2021 |title=Toni Kroos verkündet Rücktritt aus der Nationalmannschaft |url=https://www.kicker.de/toni-kroos-verkuendet-ruecktritt-aus-der-nationalmannschaft-808648/artikel |access-date=2 July 2021 |website=[[Kicker (magazine)|Kicker]] |language=de |archive-date=9 July ==Style of play==
{{Quote_box|width=20%|align=right|quote="How Toni distributes the ball, how he receives it, is very good. He's technically excellent ... He has made progress in the last few matches, I'm extremely satisfied with the player."
|source=–[[Joachim Löw]], former manager of the Germany national team<ref name="goal.com2012-04-18">{{cite news |last=Whitney |first=Clark |date=18 April 2012 |title=Better than Schweinsteiger? 'Complete package' Toni Kroos comes up big against Real Madrid |url=http://www.goal.com/en/news/1717/editorial/2012/04/18/3043549/better-than-schweinsteiger-complete-package-toni-kroos-comes |access-date=13 October 2013 |website=Goal.com |archive-date=21 June 2012 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120621021048/http://www.goal.com/en/news/1717/editorial/2012/04/18/3043549/better-than-schweinsteiger-complete-package-toni-kroos-comes |url-status=live }}</ref>}}

A tall and athletic right-footed midfielder, Kroos is regarded as one of the best midfielders of his generation and of all time. He is known for the long range and high accuracy of his passing and his ability to create goals with his passing and [[Cross (association football)|crossing]] from [[Direct free kick|set-pieces]].<ref name="90min.com_source_1"/><ref name="90min.com_source_2"/><ref name="BBCBitesize"/><ref name="FedererFootball"/><ref>{{cite web |last=Browning |first=Oliver |date=1 December 2019 |title=Toni Kroos |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231203082130/https://twitter.com/OptaFranz/status/1531208375450607616?lang=en |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://twitter.com/Squawka/status/1665450562622566406?lang=en |title=Archived copy |access-date=3 December 2023 |archive-date=3 December 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231203050134/https://twitter.com/Squawka/status/1665450562622566406?lang=en |url-status=live }}</ref> He has been described by [[Jonathan Wilson (writer)|Jonathan Wilson]] as "perhaps the archetype of the modern [[attacking midfielder]]". Wilson also described Kroos as "dynamic and hardworking", and praised him for his physical strength and versatility across several [[Midfielder|midfield]] positions. Kroos played in the [[Central midfielder|centre]] as a [[deep-lying playmaker]] or even as a [[defensive midfielder]] due to his ability to both break up play, retain possession, and create chances for teammates. At the beginning of his career, he played as an advanced midfielder, before being shifted to a deep-lying playmaker as his career progressed.<ref name="Wilson">{{cite web |date=4 April 2013 |title=The Question: How is interpretation of the playmaker role changing? |work=The Guardian |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/blog/2013/apr/04/playmaker-toni-kroos-mesut-ozil |access-date=5 October 2013 |archive-date=11 June 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200611210829/https://www.theguardian.com/football/blog/2013/apr/04/playmaker-toni-kroos-mesut-ozil |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last=Smith |first=Rory |date=5 July 2015 |title=Sneijder a man for the key moments |url=http://www.espnfc.com/blog/world-cup-central/59/post/1933592/erratic-netherlands-playmaker-wesley-sneijder-a-man-for-the-key-moments |access-date=15 August 2016 |work=ESPN FC |archive-date=5 July 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240705210717/https://www.espn.com/soccer/ |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last=Cox |first=Michael |date=12 May 2015 |title=Champions League semis showcase changing role of deep-lying midfielder |url=http://www.espnfc.us/uefa-champions-league/2/blog/post/2445308/champions-league-semis-showcase-changing-role-of-midfielder |access-date=16 August 2016 |work=ESPN FC |archive-date=17 August 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160817064140/http://www.espnfc.us/uefa-champions-league/2/blog/post/2445308/champions-league-semis-showcase-changing-role-of-midfielder |url-status=live }}</ref><ref name="Late-career Toni Kroos">{{cite news |url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/5481520/2024/05/09/toni-kroos-real-madrid-analysis-champions-league/ |title=Late-career Toni Kroos can still dominate a Champions League tie like few others |work=The New York Times |last1=Cox |first1=Michael |date=9 May 2024 |access-date=22 May 2024 |archive-date=21 May 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240521170228/https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/5481520/2024/05/09/toni-kroos-real-madrid-analysis-champions-league/ |url-status=live }}</ref> 

One of his signature moves on the ball involved him taking a run-on first touch past an opponent when receiving a pass under pressure, which allowed him to beat opponents and create space for himself,<ref name="Late-career Toni Kroos"/> despite his lack of pace;<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.espn.co.uk/football/story/_/id/40193855/why-chelsea-mauricio-pochettino-split-reveals-club |title=Why Pochettino left Chelsea, and what it reveals about the club |publisher=ESPN |date=22 May 2024 |access-date=22 May 2024 |archive-date=22 May 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240522114252/https://www.espn.co.uk/football/story/_/id/40193855/why-chelsea-mauricio-pochettino-split-reveals-club |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.90min.com/posts/barcelona-1-2-real-madrid-player-ratings-brilliant-bellingham-el-clasico-28-10-23 |title=Barcelona 1–2 Real Madrid: Player ratings as brilliant Bellingham brace wins El Clasico |website=90min |date=28 October 2023 |access-date=22 May 2024 |archive-date=22 May 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240522144155/https://www.90min.com/posts/barcelona-1-2-real-madrid-player-ratings-brilliant-bellingham-el-clasico-28-10-23 |url-status=live }}</ref> this move was dubbed the "Kroos shuffle" in the media.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/37506736/iniesta-croqueta-kroos-shuffle-modern-football-best-signature-moves |title=Modern football's greatest signature moves |publisher=ESPN |date=6 February 2019 |access-date=24 May 2024 |archive-date=24 May 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240524141633/https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/37506736/iniesta-croqueta-kroos-shuffle-modern-football-best-signature-moves |url-status=live }}</ref> Kroos had a wide variety of passes, and he was able to control the midfield with accurate short passes or start attacks with longer passes.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.espn.in/football/story/_/id/37475209/xavi-believes-toni-kroos-control-real-madrid-midfield-long-haul |title=Xavi sees Kroos at core of Real's success |publisher=ESPN |last=Álvarez |first=Eduardo |date=25 May 2017 |access-date=22 May 2024 |archive-date=22 May 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240522144155/https://www.espn.in/football/story/_/id/37475209/xavi-believes-toni-kroos-control-real-madrid-midfield-long-haul |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2886151-br-football-ranks-footballs-ultimate-passers |title=B/R Football Ranks: Football's Ultimate Passers |publisher=Bleacher Report |last1=Tighe |first1=Sam |date=13 April 2020 |access-date=22 May 2024 |archive-date=22 May 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240522144201/https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2886151-br-football-ranks-footballs-ultimate-passers |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2069493-why-toni-kroos-is-the-wrong-player-for-manchester-united |title=Why Toni Kroos Is the Wrong Player for Manchester United |publisher=Bleacher Report |last1=Fleming |first1=Chris |date=20 May 2014 |access-date=22 May 2024 |archive-date=22 May 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240522144200/https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2069493-why-toni-kroos-is-the-wrong-player-for-manchester-united |url-status=live }}</ref> Former Manchester United midfielder [[Paul Scholes]] said in 2014 that Kroos, "a top-class central midfielder", was the player that United most needed to sign.<ref name="Scholes">{{cite news |date=22 May 2014 |title=Paul Scholes: Manchester United need Bayern Munich's Toni Kroos |work=BBC Sport |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/0/football/27517443 |access-date=22 May 2014 |archive-date=5 July 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240705210721/https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/27517443 |url-status=live }}</ref> Reaffirming his high regard for Kroos years later, Scholes selected him as the best German player ever in a 2025 feature with [[TNT Sports (United Kingdom)|TNT Sports]].<ref name="tnt-scholes-2025">{{cite web |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=15I68gy3-0s |title=Paul Scholes picks out his best player per country |publisher=[[TNT Sports (United Kingdom)|TNT Sports]] |date=17 June 2025 |access-date=28 July 2026}}</ref> Former Netherlands captain [[Johan Cruyff]] said of Kroos' performances at the 2014 World Cup, "He's doing everything right: the pace in his passes is great and he sees everything. It's nearly perfect."<ref>{{cite news |date=9 July 2014 |title=Brazil have no answer to might of Toni Kroos's control for Germany |work=The Guardian |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/blog/2014/jul/08/brazil-germany-world-cup-toni-kroos |access-date=9 July 2014}}</ref>

==Personal life==
Kroos married his long-term girlfriend Jessica Farber on 13 June 2015. They have two sons and a daughter.<ref>{{cite web | url = https://www.realtotal.de/drittes-mal-vater-nachwuchs-im-hause-kroos/ | title = Drittes Mal Vater: Nachwuchs im Hause Kroos | language = de | website = Real Total | date = 26 March 2019 | access-date = 3 March 2021 | first = Nils | last = Kern | archive-date = 1 October 2023 | archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20231001140230/https://www.realtotal.de/drittes-mal-vater-nachwuchs-im-hause-kroos/ | url-status = live }}</ref> He owns a house on the island of [[Mallorca]].<ref name="Vertrag bis 2020! Kroos wechselt zu Real Madrid" /> In March 2021, Kroos said it was "wrong" for the [[2022 FIFA World Cup]] to be held in Qatar, pointing out the Gulf state's poor treatment of migrant workers and its criminalisation of homosexuality. He said that footballers should draw attention to those issues instead of boycotting the tournament.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Ford |first1=Matt |title=Kroos: 'It's wrong that the World Cup was awarded to Qatar' |url=https://www.dw.com/en/toni-kroos-its-wrong-that-the-world-cup-was-awarded-to-qatar/a-57064557 |access-date=15 July 2024 |publisher=Deutsche Welle |date=31 March 2021}}</ref> In 2023, he criticised footballers for moving to the [[Saudi Pro League]], believing that it was driven only by money.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Moragón |first1=Jorge |title=Toni Kroos lashes out at the Saudi Pro League: They say they are ambitious but it's all about money |url=https://www.marca.com/en/football/real-madrid/2023/08/31/64f0a31246163f7f2d8b456d.html |access-date=15 July 2024 |work=Marca |date=31 August 2023}}</ref> He said that he would never move to the country due to its human rights record, which prompted him to be booed while playing in the [[2024 Supercopa de España]], which was hosted in [[Saudi Arabia]].<ref>{{cite news |title='Saudi boos showed I said the right thing' says Madrid's Kroos |url=https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20240212-saudi-boos-showed-i-said-the-right-thing-says-madrid-s-kroos |access-date=15 July 2024 |publisher=France 24 |date=13 February 2024}}</ref>

Kroos called for Germans to vote in the [[2021 German federal election]], unless they were voting for the [[Alternative for Germany]], adding "nobody needs them".<ref>{{cite news |last1=Abasi |first1=Ares |title="Braucht niemand": Toni Kroos rechnet mit AfD ab |url=https://www.fr.de/politik/toni-kroos-bundestagswahl-afd-corona-impfung-interview-zr-90917273.html |access-date=15 July 2024 |work=Frankfurter Runschau |date=12 August 2021 |language=German}}</ref> In July 2024, Kroos said on the [[ZDF]] ''Lanz & Precht'' podcast that Germany was not the same country that he had left ten years earlier, and he said that his daughter would be safer in Spain. Later in the discussion, he said that he supported [[immigration to Germany]] "1000%" but felt that it had been "uncontrolled" and had allowed some "not good" people to enter. Kroos's interview was misinterpreted and many thought he was suggesting a link between [[immigration and crime in Germany]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Schlecht übersetzt: Toni Kroos wird nach Interview Rassismus vorgeworfen |url=https://www.derstandard.de/story/3000000227624/schlecht-uebersetzt-toni-kroos-wird-nach-interview-rassismus-vorgeworfen |access-date=15 July 2024 |work=Der Standard |date=9 July 2024 |language=German}}</ref>
